node.statement: Outer-compressed diagonal isomorphism. The reset state gives v_U:M_|U|->A_U=S^A_{P_U} as an extended d_U-isomorphism, hence as an extended t-isomorphism since d_U<=t. By lem-maincb-outer-compression-transfer applied to R=P_R and P=P_U, T=Co^{A_R}_{P_U^R} o Co^A_{P_R} o v_U is an extended C_out*t-isomorphism M_|U|->S^{A_R}_{P_U^R}, with T_n=I_n tensor T for every n.
